purpose: Falsify H0.25 on simulator families not used in its development and not reducible to a single global temperature shift.

models.candidate: H0.25 = sequential probability mixture over temperatures [1.0,1.5,2.0,3.0,4.0] with weights [0.15,0.15,0.40,0.15,0.15]

frozen_retain_rule.per_seed: H0.25 maximum primary regret must be < R0_T2 maximum primary regret AND H0.25 mean primary regret must be <= R0_T2 mean primary regret + 0.0025
frozen_retain_rule.replication: rule must pass independently in both seeds
frozen_retain_rule.failure: any seed failure rejects H0.25 as current broad synthetic robustness lead; no post-hoc threshold change

development_firewall: No H0.25 weight or temperature changes are allowed after this preregistration using these fresh worlds. Any successor must receive a new ID and use only consumed worlds for development before another fresh preregistered battery.
